title: Stable continuous work and rider handoff 2026-10-18
assumptions: Live policy read 2026-10-18T15:03:13Z: 20 Vault per completed order, shared 100 orders per UUID per UTC day, reward policy SHA256 51473a9539fcd0aeb7cf8e3109ad756c6396b8a361ab6e65faadb99c893aae87. No monetary value, currency conversion, quota or payout journal change.

Before: player waits through horse approach and 5-second hay eating. After: accepted hay placement completes the order immediately; eating and return retain an animal-only lease. New care orders always include both ties, 3 brushes, saddle, untie and outdoor rider handoff; background ride is unpaid.

Low/base/high sensitivity assumptions, not measured: participants 5/20/50, active hours per day 0.25/1/2. Before capacity 40/40/50 orders/hour ->10/40/100 orders/day. After capacity 44/44/55 orders/hour ->11/44/100 orders/day after unchanged cap. The 10 percent cadence increase is an explicit sensitivity, not a prediction; longer care can offset hay wait removal.

At matched order counts, before/after amounts are identical. Maximum remains 2000 Vault per UUID/day; no global weekly budget exists. Multiple eligible accounts still scale linearly; no new per-action reward or permanent tool redemption is introduced.

Independent player tasks cannot claim eating/riding horses. Background work retains actor ownership until cleanup and does not award a second order; actual-player leases remain exclusive. Reload/logout/timeout must cancel or finish owned visuals and return horses without duplicate acceptance.

Vault includes admin mint67001499 and concentrated shop sales, so aggregate income/activity buckets are not an ordinary-player hourly baseline. Top-source audit does not isolate Origin job cadence.

EconomyShopGUI SELL is currently active (shop_sell income5746253.95 in this window). Planned SELL-to-contract transition is future scope and unchanged. Temporary hay/water/lead/brush/saddle are work markers with no SELL/contract redemption. No new item, XP, token or entitlement reward.

No accumulation price or progression cost changes; disposable income cannot be inferred reliably from this mixed ledger. New sensitivity adds20/80/0 Vault per player-day in low/base/high; actual cadence requires behavioral measurement after activation.
